ILI双poly搬运八硫温差
无flag双控搬运逻辑，最远离核90格
搬运逻辑算法消灭了单位的停顿时间，并且优先供给物品最少的建筑，基本上完全利用了单位的运力。
尚不支持超速。

ILI Dual-Poly Transport 8-Sulfur Differential Generator

Flagless dual-control transport logic.
Maximum operating distance: 90 tiles from the core.

The transport algorithm eliminates unit idle time and prioritizes buildings with the lowest item count, making near-complete use of unit carrying capacity.

Overdrive support is not yet implemented.
